statement: Read allocation/<bg-type>/bg_reclaim_threshold for the block-group reclaim threshold the kernel reports for that type; a write of 0 through 100 sets it, and the write is refused while dynamic_reclaim is enabled.

The allocation directory lists exactly two attributes, global_rsv_size and global_rsv_reserved, both defined by the read-only attribute macro that gives mode 0444, so any user can read the global block reserve without root.
